title: A Rainy Shopping Trip
setting: Sara's kitchen and a street near Omar's small food shop.

characters.name: Sara
characters.look: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt)

characters.name: Omar
characters.look: Omar (a round-faced man of about fifty-five with a grey moustache, a flat cap and a white apron)

sentences.en: Sara comes home from work and opens the fridge.
sentences.zh: 萨拉下班回家，打开了冰箱。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt), in a blue coat, opens a fridge in her kitchen, still holding her bag.

sentences.en: She can see only one small potato.
sentences.scene_prompt: Inside a nearly empty fridge sits one small potato.

sentences.en: She writes a short shopping list.
sentences.zh: 她写了一张简短的购物清单。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) writes on a small notepad at the kitchen table, the empty fridge open behind her.

sentences.en: Soon the sky is dark and grey.
sentences.zh: 不久，天空变得又暗又灰。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dark grey clouds fill the sky over a street, seen from a kitchen window.
sentences.draw_note: Shows a dark grey sky; 'soon' can't be shown.

sentences.en: "I hate rain," says Sara, and takes an umbrella.
sentences.zh: “我讨厌下雨。”萨拉说着，拿起了一把雨伞。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt), in a blue coat, frowns at the rain and picks up an umbrella by the door.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Sara frowning at the rain and taking an umbrella; the spoken words can only be guessed.

sentences.en: She walks around the corner in her coat.
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt), in a blue coat, walks around a street corner under her umbrella in light rain.

sentences.en: After a minute, she meets Omar by his shop.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，她在奥马尔的店旁遇见了他。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt), in a blue coat with an umbrella, meets Omar (a round-faced man of about fifty-five with a grey moustache, a flat cap and a white apron) in front of his small food shop; they greet each other.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Sara meeting Omar at his shop; 'after a minute' can't be shown.

sentences.en: "Come back later for my soup," says Omar.
sentences.zh: “晚点回来尝尝我的汤吧。”奥马尔说。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar (a round-faced man of about fifty-five with a grey moustache, a flat cap and a white apron) hands Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) a paper bag of potatoes at the shop door and points inside to a big steaming pot of soup.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Omar giving Sara potatoes and pointing to his soup; the invitation and 'later' can only be guessed.
